retrievalProfile.description: A centered, circular occult sigil featuring a heart-integrated hexagram enclosed by an Ouroboros and runic rings against a textured, split-background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central black-and-white emblem consisting of a six-pointed star merged with a heart shape, surrounded by concentric rings containing runic-style characters and a snake eating its own tail (Ouroboros). The background is split horizontally between a radiating sunburst texture and a geometric 3D cube pattern.
coreVisualRelationships: Centralized symmetry of the primary sigil
Concentric layering of the Ouroboros and runic rings
High contrast between the white inner circle and black graphic elements
coreInvariants: The integration of a heart shape into the lower half of a geometric hexagram.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The sigil is perfectly centered and occupies approximately 70% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular motion following the Ouroboros and runic rings, leading inward to the central symbol.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: High-contrast white space within the central circle provides breathing room for the complex linework.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black for all primary graphic linework and symbols.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white/Cream for the central circular background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted grey-green and charcoal for the textured background patterns.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast in the center, transitioning to mid-tones in the background.
paletteRestrictions: Monochromatic or desaturated earth tones only

characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical orientation for the top-center glyph
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single consistent symbolic style across all rings.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the angular, ancient aesthetic of the symbols.
Provides the esoteric and mystical feel required.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a split background with a radiating sunburst texture on top and a 3D geometric cube pattern on the bottom, both in muted charcoal and grey-green tones. Place a large white circle in the center with a thick black Ouroboros border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a black hexagram integrated with a heart shape in the center. Fill the white rings between the Ouroboros and the center with hand-drawn angular runic symbols.

verificationChecks: Is the heart integrated into the hexagram?
Is the Ouroboros present as the outermost ring?
Are the runes arranged in concentric circles?
Is the background split horizontally with two distinct textures?

adjustableVariables: Stroke weight of the central sigil
postGenerationChecks: Check for Ouroboros head and tail connection
Ensure the heart and star are perfectly centered
Verify the background split is horizontal
Confirm the runic characters are angular and non-Latin
recipe.reuseFormula: Central [Geometric Sigil] + [Ouroboros Border] + [Runic Rings] + [Split Textured Background]
